giver: Organisation representatives in any village, from each organisation's pool (one errand per villager, picked by the villager's identity), plus the outcast fishermen on their boats and the sky villagers.
feel: Small jobs that send the player to the nearest well, ruin, camp, stall or boat: quick, local and repeatable in spirit, each with a little story. Good for learning the land around each village.

quests.title: Water from Three Wells
quests.summary: A cleric of the Herbalists swears each well's water brews differently. Bring her a bottle of water from three different wells.

quests.title: Make a Wish
quests.summary: A young Herbalist lost her lucky coin in a wishing well. Find the wishing well she describes and fish the coin out from the bottom.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, a potion of luck

quests.title: Desert Water
quests.summary: The Growers' co-op says the desert wells never run dry. Bring back a bucket from a desert well and a cutting of the cactus beside it.

quests.title: The Pump Still Works
quests.summary: A desert village's farmer needs water for a new field. Find a working desert pump, fill buckets there and water her field.

quests.title: Restore the Fountain
quests.summary: A Crafters' guild mason wants a stone fountain copied for the village square. Visit a fountain in the wild, take its measurements and build one at home.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, Supplementaries fountain parts, stone bricks

quests.title: The Travelling Market
quests.summary: A Tavern keeper heard the roadside stalls sell spices you can't get in town. Find two stalls and a cart and bring back what their owners left behind.
quests.reward: Cooking XP, Farmer's Delight spices and crops

quests.title: The Lost Cart
quests.summary: A courier's bamboo cart broke down in the jungle with parcels aboard. Find the cart and carry its parcels (Carry On helps with the crate) to the jungle village.

quests.title: A Stall of Your Own
quests.summary: The Growers' co-op want a stall at the next market. Copy a roadside stall's look and set one up in the village with produce on display.
quests.reward: Farming XP, a service bell, emeralds

quests.title: Salvage
quests.summary: The Crafters' guild needs old stone with history. Bring back blocks from two different ruins near the village.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a chisel-worthy stack of stone bricks

quests.title: Scout the Castle
quests.summary: The Village watch fear raiders camp in the old castle ruins. Scout the ruins, count what you find, and report back.

quests.title: Statue Rubbings
quests.summary: A librarian of the Arcane order wants copies of the carvings on fallen statues. Take rubbings (paper and charcoal) from statue ruins and a log ruin.

quests.title: Ruins on the Map
quests.summary: A courier is mapping the wild ruins for travellers. Visit a desert ruin, a jungle ruin and a swamp ruin, and mark them.

quests.title: Who Left the Camp?
quests.summary: The Village watch found an abandoned camp, fire still warm. Search it for clues and track the campers to where they went.

quests.title: Cook over an Open Fire
quests.summary: A Tavern keeper says food tastes better outdoors. Cook a meal at a wild fire camp and bring it back still warm.

quests.title: The Outcast Fisherman
quests.summary: The Anglers' society talk of a fisherman who left his village to live on a boat. Find one of the outcast villagers' boats at sea and trade with him for his best bait.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, Aquaculture worms, a Small Ships boat

quests.title: Supplies for the Boat
quests.summary: The fisherman on the boat is out of bread and rope. Sail them out to him and he shares where the big fish bite.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, a Lili's Lucky Lures lure

quests.title: Storm at Sea
quests.summary: A thunderstorm has caught a fisherman's boat far out. Reach him before the storm ends and bring him back to the village harbour.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, a Small Ships cog, an enchanted rod

quests.title: A Parcel for the Sky
quests.summary: The Couriers have a parcel addressed to a sky village. Get it up there within a day (no flying machines yet) and collect the signature.

quests.title: Seeds for the Sky Farms
quests.summary: Sky villagers can't get seeds up from the ground. Bring them seeds of four crops and help plant their island fields.

quests.title: The Long Way Down
quests.summary: A sky villager's child fell off the edge and floated down on a parasol. Find her on the ground below and get her back up safely.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a slow falling potion, a beach parasol

quests.title: Map the Region
quests.summary: A courier sends the player to the cartographer's tower in the wilds. Climb it, copy its master map and fill in the area around your village.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a globe, an Explorer's Compass

quests.title: The Runaway Horse
quests.summary: A Sanctuary keeper's horse ran off to a wild horse pen. Find it, ride it back and stable it.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a saddle, golden carrots

quests.title: The Fox in the Hut
quests.summary: Foxes have taken over a hut in the taiga. Breed a pair with sweet berries and bring a kit back to the Sanctuary.

quests.title: Sled Dogs
quests.summary: The Sanctuary keepers want a sled team. Tame wolves near a snowy dog hut and ride a Snowy Spirit sled pulled by one across the snow in good time.

quests.title: Honey from the Dome
quests.summary: The Herbalists need honey from the bee dome in the birch woods. Calm the bees with a campfire and bring back honey and a comb.

quests.title: The Flour Run
quests.summary: The Growers' co-op's mill has broken. Take wheat to a windmill in the wild, grind it and bring the flour back for the baker.
quests.reward: Farming XP, Farm & Charm flour, bread

quests.title: Letter to Another Village
quests.summary: A courier hands over a letter for a villager in the next village along the road. Deliver it by Friends of the Forest mail or in person, and bring back the reply.

quests.title: Behind the Walls
quests.summary: The Village watch's captain wants to learn from a fortified village. Visit one, talk to its guards and help them hold the wall through one night.
quests.reward: Defense XP, a Spartan Shields shield

quests.title: Linking the Villages
quests.summary: The Couriers want the village's waystone linked to the next village's. Attune both and carry a warp stone between them.

quests.title: Justice
quests.summary: The Village watch want the bandit who robbed a merchant brought in. Track him to the gallows hill he hides near and defeat him.

quests.title: Something Smells Funny
quests.summary: Every time the village's butcher sits down, there's a rude noise, and the whole village laughs. Follow the trail of giggles and stray feathers through the houses to the mischievous villager behind it, who gives up the whoopee cushion only after you catch him in a game of hide and seek.
quests.reward: Agility XP, the Whoopee Cushion, cake

quests.title: The Jungle Village
quests.summary: The Couriers have never reached the village in the sparse jungle. Find it, introduce yourself and bring back a list of what they trade.
